categories.name: wallet
categories.evidence: Touches wallet migration logic in `CWallet::ApplyMigrationData` and wallet database transaction listeners.
categories.rationale: Fixes a complete failure during legacy-to-descriptor wallet migration for watch-only wallets with transaction history. As noted in issue #36483, `migratewallet` currently throws an unhandled `std::bad_function_call` exception and leaves the wallet unmigrated, directly impacting migration correctness.
